guide_solution: (a) Hospitality has long been a part of our culture in Bangladesh. (b) Although many other things are changing now, people are still quite polite and friendly towards foreigners. (c) It is quite common for Bangladeshis to ask personal questions about family, jobs and income which visitors from overseas might find awkward. (d) However it should be understood that no harm is meant by such questions on the other hand, they express genuine interest in the foreigner's state of affairs. (e) Actually, it is common practice for the people of Bangladesh to know the details of a foreigner.
